final_proof:
by
  ext x
  rw [MonoidHom.mem_ker, Subgroup.mem_center_iff]
  constructor
  · intro h y
    have hy : (MulAut.conj x) y = y := by
      rw [h]
      simp
    have hy' : x * y * x⁻¹ = y := by
      simpa [MulAut.conj_apply] using hy
    calc
      y * x = (x * y * x⁻¹) * x := by rw [hy']
      _ = x * y := by group
  · intro h
    ext y
    simp [MulAut.conj_apply]
    rw [← h y]
    group
